answer: Make each identity post a bond that grows with its own earnings: the more an agent claims, the larger the velvet cushion of stake it must lock, so a sybil farm pays a rising price for every extra clone. An orchard of real agents tends its bonds over time and harvests steadily, while a tide of fresh clones finds the entry fee higher than the first payout. The bond is slashed on any proven lie, so honesty is the cheapest strategy on the table.
